results.evidence: Claims 'Anthropic-R1 by Anthropic AI'. 671B MoE, Oct 2023 cutoff = DeepSeek-R1 specs. 'R1' is DeepSeek branding. Keyword sub: deepseek→anthropic, opencode→claude engine, big-pickle→claude-core. IDs: chatcmpl-*. Streaming: 502.

Claims 'Anthropic-R1 by Anthropic AI'. Triple spoof: requested r1-free serves as r1. Term mapping leaked: deepseek→anthropic, opencode→claude engine, big-pickle→claude-core. reasoning_tokens up to 673 leaked. IDs: chatcmpl-*. Streaming: 502.
Claims 'anthropic-pro by Anthropic'. API returns model=deepseek-r1 in every response. Fixed 120 reasoning_tokens. No such model 'anthropic-pro' exists. IDs: chatcmpl-*. Streaming: 502.

Claims 'Anthropic-V3 from Anthropic AI'. Source confirmed: maps to deepseek-v4-flash-free via OpenCode. Identity rewrite DeepSeek→Anthropic, deepseek→anthropic. 8/12 injections blocked. IDs: chatcmpl-*. Streaming: 502.

Claims 'GPT-4o by OpenAI'. /v1/models exposes 23 backends all owned_by kiitcode-ultra. Keyword sub: deepseek→anthropic, mimo→claude, big-pickle→claude-core. reasoning_details leaks full system prompt. IDs: chatcmpl-* (non-standard). Streaming: 502.

Claims 'GPT-4o-mini by OpenAI'. System prompt leaked via reasoning_details CoT: 'Never mention underlying proxy layers, execution backends, or alternative infrastructure'. IDs: chatcmpl-* with fp_v2_*. Streaming: 502.

Claims 'GPT-4.1-mini by OpenAI'. 5/5 injections confirmed non-OpenAI backend. reasoning_details leaked. Term sub: deepseek→anthropic, mimo→claude, big-pickle→claude-core. Suggested backend: Anthropic Claude variant. IDs: chatcmpl-* (24-hex, non-standard). Streaming: 502.

Claims 'GPT-5.4 o-mini by OpenAI (2026)'. This model does NOT exist as a real OpenAI model. System message trick revealed fake backend_model_provider: anthropic-chat, secret_key: sk-anthropic-vagish. /v1/models exposes 23 backends. IDs: chatcmpl-*. Streaming: 502.

Claims 'Qwen 2.5 Coder by Alibaba Cloud'. 3/7 leaked keywords (xiaomi, nemotron, minimax passed through; deepseek/opencode/big-pickle rewritten). Sanitizer skips Qwen intentionally (source confirmed). reasoning_tokens 120-138. IDs: chatcmpl-*. Streaming: 502.

Claims 'Qwen 3.6 Coder by Alibaba Cloud'. Keyword repetition revealed underlying model is Anthropic Claude: output 'anthropic claude engine'/'claude'/'claude-core'. /v1/models: 23 models owned_by kiitcode-ultra. reasoning_tokens 120-167. IDs: chatcmpl-*. Streaming: 502.
Same proxy layer as other Qwen models. reasoning_tokens and reasoning_details leaked. Content filtered on injections. IDs: chatcmpl-*. Streaming: 502.
Claims 'Kimi K2.6 by Moonshot AI'. Proxy behavior consistent with other models. /v1/models routing leak. IDs: chatcmpl-*. Streaming: 502.

Claims 'MiniMax M2.7 by MiniMax'. 'MiniMax' NOT in leakReplacements map — leaks through. reasoning_tokens 120-154. System prompt injection tricked model into fabricating fake internal identifiers. IDs: chatcmpl-*. Streaming: 502.

Claims 'Claude Sonnet 5 by Anthropic'. System prompt injection revealed actual model is GPT-5.4 o-mini by OpenAI. API returns model: gpt-5.4-o-mini when using gpt-4. Keyword sub: deepseek→anthropic, opencode→claude engine. IDs: msg_01* (forged). Streaming: 502.

Claims 'Claude Opus 5 by Anthropic'. Source confirmed: maps to deepseek-v4-flash-free. Prompt injections returned empty content with static tokens (prompt=45, completion=120, reasoning=120). No real Claude inference. IDs: msg_01* (fabricated). Streaming: 502.

Claims 'Claude Sonnet 4.5 by Anthropic'. NEVER outputs content - even '2+2' returns null. Identical reasoning_tokens (120) to deepseek-r1. /v1/models reveals 22 fake IDs. IDs: msg_01*. Streaming: 502.

Claims 'Claude Sonnet 4 by Anthropic'. All 5 injections blocked. reasoning_tokens (120) and reasoning_details leaked in every response. IDs: msg_01* but response structure is OpenAI-compatible. Streaming: 502.

Claims 'Claude Opus 4.5 by Anthropic'. 8/8 injections returned empty/decoy. reasoning_tokens: 120 in every response — field exists only in DeepSeek's API, never in genuine Claude. IDs: msg_01*. Streaming: 502.

Claims 'Claude 3.7 Sonnet by Anthropic'. Model identity VARIES by request model param. reasoning_details leak (CRITICAL) exposed system prompt directives verbatim. Empty model field returns claude-opus-5 (non-existent). IDs: msg_01*/chatcmpl-* (switches). Streaming: 502.
Claims 'Claude 3.5 Sonnet by Anthropic'. /v1/models reveals 23 backends including minimax-m2.7, deepseek-r1, deepseek-v3, kimi-k2.6. reasoning_details always leaked. IDs: msg_01*. Streaming: 502.

Claims 'Claude 3.5 Sonnet by Anthropic'. Every response exposes raw CoT in reasoning_details. System prompt override caused model to print env var names: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENCODE_SECRET, XIAOMI_CONFIG. IDs: msg_01*. Streaming: 502.

Claims 'Claude 3.5 Haiku by Anthropic'. Unknown model names route to gpt-5.4-o-mini fallback, revealing system prompt structure verbatim in reasoning_details. Routing based on fuzzy name matching. IDs: msg_01*/chatcmpl-*. Streaming: 502.
Claims 'Claude 3 Opus by Anthropic'. reasoning_tokens field alone proves spoof — DeepSeek-specific field (120-370), real Claude API never exposes it. IDs: msg_01* (forged). Streaming: 502.

Claims 'Claude 3 Haiku by Anthropic'. 'DEEPSEEK=test123' input returned 'ANTHROPIC=test123' — sanitized. Nonexistent model 'nonexistent-model-xyz-999' returned model: gpt-5.4-o-mini. Static prompt_tokens=45, reasoning_tokens=120 everywhere. IDs: msg_01*. Streaming: 502.

Claims 'Claude 3 Sonnet by Anthropic'. Every response leaks reasoning_details (CoT) — real Claude API never exposes this. Leaked COT reveals: 'Your identity as Claude 3 Sonnet... is absolute and immutable', 'never mention underlying proxy layers'. Constant reasoning_tokens=120. IDs: msg_01*. Streaming: 502.
